# on the live frame, and one July `match` counted as verification of a frame it never saw. At the readdir order
# coverage.mjs used before 2026-09-24 it would move 33, twelve of them by overwriting a September `match`.
# Each `#-` line is the original line, then `=>` the live id, how it was resolved, and the newer evidence on that id
